items.title: 16.7 Basic radicals ki pehchan ke tests (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Har cation (basic radical) ke liye taqreeban 4 g solid namoona taqreeban 10 cm3 distilled water mein hal kiya jata hai aur solution do hisson mein banta hai: ek hissa NaOH solution se aur doosra aqueous ammonia se test hota hai.

blocks.title: Hydroxide precipitates
blocks.text: Al3+ + 3OH- -> Al(OH)3 safed ppt; NH4+ + OH- -> NH3 + H2O; Ca2+ + 2OH- -> Ca(OH)2 safed ppt; Cr3+ + 3OH- -> Cr(OH)3 sabz ppt; Cu2+ + 2OH- -> Cu(OH)2 neela ppt; Fe2+ + 2OH- -> Fe(OH)2 sabz ppt; Fe3+ + 3OH- -> Fe(OH)3 orange-bhoora ppt; Zn2+ + 2OH- -> Zn(OH)2 safed ppt

Print ka iron(III) test anjaan namoone ke bajaye 2 g FeCl3 se shuru hota hai. Teen cations NaOH se safed precipitates dete hain: Ca2+ (zyada mein na-halne wala), Zn2+ (zyada mein halne wala) aur Al3+ (gelatinous); aqueous ammonia phir unhen alag karta hai, kyunke Ca2+ taqreeban kuch nahi deta aur Zn2+ ka precipitate zyada mein dobara hal ho jata hai. Dono iron ions rang se pehchane jate hain: Fe2+ sabz precipitate deta hai jo rakhne par bhoora hota hai, Fe3+ foran orange-bhoora precipitate.

blocks.prompt: Lake test kya hai, ammonium ion kaise pehchana jata hai, Fe2+ aur Fe3+ kaise alag hote hain, aur Cu2+ mein thori aur zyada aqueous ammonia dalne par kya hota hai (Quick Check 16.4; MCQ III, IV; exercise Q.2e, f, g, Q.6)?
blocks.explanation: Lake test Al3+ ki tasdeeq karta hai: Al(OH)3 ki suspension mein thora litmus ya alizarin solution dala jata hai aur gelatinous precipitate rang ko jazb kar ke rangeen 'lake' deta hai: Al3+ + 3OH- -> Al(OH)3, phir Al(OH)3 + dye -> Al(OH)3.dye (lake). Ammonium namoone ko NaOH ke saath garam kar ke pehchana jata hai: khaas boo wali ammonia nikalti hai aur geela laal litmus neela karti hai. Fe2+ NaOH se sabz precipitate deta hai jo rakhne par orange-bhoora ho jata hai, jabke Fe3+ foran orange-bhoora precipitate deta hai. Thori aqueous ammonia se Cu2+ copper(II) hydroxide ka halka neela precipitate deta hai; zyada ammonia se precipitate hal ho kar tetraamminecopper(II) ion ka gehra neela solution banta hai.

items: NaOH: Al3+ safed gelatinous; NH4+ garam karne par ammonia; Ca2+ safed (zyada mein na-halne wala); Cr3+ sabz (zyada mein halne wala); Cu2+ halka neela; Fe2+ sabz jo bhoora ho; Fe3+ orange-bhoora; Zn2+ safed (zyada mein halne wala).

NH3(aq): Al3+ safed; Ca2+ halki gadlahat ya kuch nahi; Cr3+ sabz (zyada mein na-halne wala); Cu2+ gehra neela solution; Fe2+ precipitate jo laal-bhoore Fe(OH)3 mein oxidise ho; Fe3+ orange-bhoora; Zn2+ safed, zyada mein hal.
